items.title: Don Albert Interview, 1972-09-18
items.q: Not too well, just a few of them. I remember when the singer Al Hibbler went to Jay McShann.

ctx.x: Right, right. Well, that's the attitude that this fellow had. Yeah. At a certain time of the month, he would just automatically change.
He just, I think we've got the microphone set there. Well, what about most of the guys in the band? How would you compare them, say, as, you know the guys in the Jay McShann band?

Not too well, just a few of them. I remember when the singer Al Hibbler went to Jay McShann. He was probably, all of the guys in there knew me personally. Mm-hmm. But, I've forgotten quite a number of those guys unless they come up and refresh my memory and then I can recognize them.
